head: native_vector

representations: recurrence state: i64 at 2^-16; three previous drive rows: i32 at 2^-16
normalized values: i64 at 2^-24; product activations: i16 at a dynamic exponent
native readout query: i32 at Q12, clamped to [-32768,32767]
route maps: one input 8-block atom, eight 3-bit signed-permutation coordinates per output block
operation_order: token id selects the shared token/writer row and converts Q12 to residual Q16
for each layer: recurrence RMS norm, gain, rec_in/rec_gate gathers, bias/tap recurrence, transition action, Hamilton output gate and rec_out residual add
same layer: MLP RMS norm, gain, mlp_gate/mlp_up gathers, Hamilton feed-forward, dynamic i16 quantize, mlp_down residual add
a Hamming read runs after its declared layer depth; a read at the layer count runs after the final norm
final RMS norm and gain, optional readout Hamming read, then optional exact opening/reply memory move
convert the final residual to Q12 and run the artifact-declared nearest or native writer head
on an opening exact-key miss with a point table, the point key may replace the head token
rounding: fixed shifts add half a unit before an arithmetic right shift; expansion shifts saturate i64
the RMS mean division and reciprocal truncate, isqrt returns floor, and the normalized quotient rounds through the serving kernel's half-up shift
Hamilton products round through the serving kernels' half-up integer shifts
dynamic i16 activation quantization selects its exponent from the maximum magnitude and rounds each value once
Hamming, memory and readout payload arithmetic use the integer kernels' signed half-away-from-zero shift

Hamming head means divide the weighted payload sum by the number of nonzero-weight kept positions, then divide the per-head sums by the number of contributing heads; both integer quotients truncate toward zero
saturation: i16 product activations clamp at [-32767,32767] after exponent selection
integer kernel additions/shifts clamp or wrap exactly as the serving kernel implementation specifies; the CPU oracle mirrors that order
route gathers convert to residual exponent with the serving rounded shift; residual additions saturate i32
memory moves round the weighted interpolation once and clamp only at the i64 boundary
ties: Hamming candidates order by (distance, earlier position) and keep the first K
whole-table nearest and kept-cell token scans choose the smaller token id on an exact score tie
native writer cells choose the smaller cell id on an exact score tie
point-key targets choose the commonest target, then the smaller target id, on the least L1 distance
icosian transitions and gates choose the first root minimizing H4 distance, as the shared serving selector does
reads: copy heads key the writer-table points and rank prior positions by popcount XOR
type heads use the read's query rotation to name a Hamming word and its value rotation to produce the candidate payload
copy/type mixtures and per-channel weights are added at the depth recorded in the artifact
at t stream tokens the current serving call scans s in 1..t-1, so it excludes the immediately preceding position t-1; this audit models that observed range rather than the documented ideal
no dense attention, probability normalization or exponentiation is present
memory: opening and reply keys are exact token vectors looked up in sorted tables
turn ids are cut from the current key-window block after the latest BOS/EOS boundary, capped by the artifact's k or reply-turn limit
a reply key is the retained turn ids when that prompt row is in the block, then MEMORY_PAD, reply length, MEMORY_PAD and the current token
MEMORY_PAD is a key separator and trailing pads are not part of the exact key
a hit moves the final normalized point toward the named writer row by the table's per-channel Q24 weight
an opening miss may scan the point table once; equal least distances are grouped by target and counted
readout: native vector: score 256 root-pair cells by Q12 L1, keep K with smaller-cell ties, then scan only those cells' writer rows with smaller-token ties
native vector nearest: scan every writer row by Q12 L1 with smaller-token ties and keep no cells

cost_basis: stage table bytes are semantic decoded-table footprints (shared tables may recur); serialized and decoded-resident totals are separate; candidates come from artifact dimensions and position; readout coordinates model the serving kernel's precomputed root scores; none are hardware cache or performance counters

surrogate_gradient_operations.operation: export rounding of trunk, Hamming tables and memory weights
surrogate_gradient_operations.exact_artifact_forward: operates only on already-quantized artifact values
surrogate_gradient_operations.float_training_behavior: train-as-served rounds float variables in place before each training forward and restores the float masters afterward
surrogate_gradient_operations.rationale: the round is piecewise constant and has zero almost everywhere; the float master needs the served forward's upstream gradient

surrogate_gradient_operations.operation: icosian snap for recurrence transitions and Hamilton gates
surrogate_gradient_operations.exact_artifact_forward: selects a discrete H4 root and applies its exact signed action
surrogate_gradient_operations.float_training_behavior: float forward uses the snapped root while the backward carries the local S^3 tangent gradient
surrogate_gradient_operations.rationale: root identity is discrete; the pre-snap transport direction remains the trainable quantity

surrogate_gradient_operations.operation: raw quaternion normalization and Hamilton products
surrogate_gradient_operations.exact_artifact_forward: integer square root/division and integer Hamilton multiplication
surrogate_gradient_operations.float_training_behavior: ordinary differentiable float normalization and Hamilton product followed by export rounding
surrogate_gradient_operations.rationale: the float shadow can differentiate the same rational expression before finite quantized evaluation
surrogate_gradient_operations.evidence: crates/uor-r4-cpu-train/src/fbs.rs: raw_rotation, hamilton_scale; float train Hamilton kernels

surrogate_gradient_operations.exact_artifact_forward: chooses an exponent from maximum magnitude, rounds once and clamps
surrogate_gradient_operations.float_training_behavior: float activations remain differentiable until export rounding
surrogate_gradient_operations.rationale: the exponent and integer residue are discrete; train-as-served does not yet route its float training forward through this activation quantizer

surrogate_gradient_operations.exact_artifact_forward: sorts exact popcount XOR distances and reads the kept positions
surrogate_gradient_operations.float_training_behavior: sign codes are produced with a straight-through sign bridge and payloads retain a differentiable path
surrogate_gradient_operations.rationale: hard candidate identity has no useful dense derivative; code and payload parameters need local credit

surrogate_gradient_operations.exact_artifact_forward: binary-searches token keys; only a hit applies a move
surrogate_gradient_operations.float_training_behavior: the float read chooses its memory rows and moves through a differentiable weighted point operation
surrogate_gradient_operations.rationale: the discrete key identity is not differentiated; hit weights and move weights carry gradient

surrogate_gradient_operations.operation: point-key fallback on an opening miss
surrogate_gradient_operations.exact_artifact_forward: scans exact Q12 L1 rows and returns the commonest least-distance target
surrogate_gradient_operations.float_training_behavior: the float reference forms an L1-named opening through a detached decision path
surrogate_gradient_operations.rationale: the named token is discrete; query-table parameters require an explicit surrogate or table update

surrogate_gradient_operations.operation: native writer cell and token selection
surrogate_gradient_operations.exact_artifact_forward: hard top-K cells and hard smallest-token tie break
surrogate_gradient_operations.float_training_behavior: float cross-entropy and rank-margin objectives train token/address scores rather than the discrete selection
surrogate_gradient_operations.rationale: hard top-K has no dense derivative; registered rank-margin and secant descent provide downstream credit through score margins

surrogate_gradient_operations.operation: integer RMS reciprocal and exponent bookkeeping
surrogate_gradient_operations.exact_artifact_forward: isqrt and reciprocal round to finite integer values
surrogate_gradient_operations.float_training_behavior: float RMSNorm is differentiable; export changes the finite values
surrogate_gradient_operations.rationale: the algebraic float normalization is differentiable, while the served isqrt/reciprocal and exponent changes are finite and need an explicit straight-through boundary

surrogate_gradient_operations.exact_artifact_forward: absent: serving applies every exact memory hit
surrogate_gradient_operations.float_training_behavior: a deterministic PRNG drops configured training windows so the trunk is also trained without memory
surrogate_gradient_operations.rationale: the mask is discrete and training-only; no current contract states how a dropout-conditioned float state maps back to the served memory-on state

surrogate_gradient_operations.operation: reply Hamming row cut during training
surrogate_gradient_operations.exact_artifact_forward: absent: serving exposes all causal prior positions
surrogate_gradient_operations.float_training_behavior: reply-row training limits the Hamming read to positions before the current reply or omits it before the reply
surrogate_gradient_operations.rationale: the row-selection mask is discrete and has no served counterpart; whether this train-only conditioning should be retained or eliminated needs a registered comparison

surrogate_gradient_operations.operation: gradient through a full artifact-only integer hidden trajectory
surrogate_gradient_operations.float_training_behavior: train-as-served still executes the ordinary float forward and rounds values before each step
surrogate_gradient_operations.rationale: no registered trainer currently backpropagates through the exact integer route, snap, quantize and selection graph

timing.measurement: single fresh, uninstrumented parity pass followed by separate fresh CPU-oracle and CPU-serving timing passes; no warm-up
